description: This file defines a routing component for a ToDo application using the Enyo framework, mapping URL paths to handler functions that update the application state.

classes.name: ToDo.Routes
classes.description: An Enyo kind that manages URL routing for the ToDo application, handling navigation to different views based on URL paths.
